_doc: The pause plan of the pointing voice, SCRIPT v3 (read by pt3_build.py, pt3_verify.py). Made from SCRIPT_v3.md section 4.2 (and the cut order 4.3). Every value is TRUE silence (10 ms RMS windows every 5 ms under -45 dBFS) between the acoustic end of one line and the first WORD of the next. A pause is cut, or silence is added: the audio is never stretched.

cut_order.what: the N pauses to their floors (saves 0.45 s)
four picture holds to their floors (saves 0.59 s)
v3_t05 becomes a silent mock point held 0.9 s (saves 1.5 s)

word_onsets_measured._doc: 2026-11-20 (voice owner): word STARTS inside connected speech measured by hand on the dialogue stem (10 ms frames: level, >3 kHz and <400 Hz energy share, spectral peak, f0), where Whisper put the start on the vowel 0.06-0.18 s late. Value = seconds from the start ('on') of the unit that holds the word; key = the word's index in the whole line (0 = first word, not set: moving 'What's' of v3_t03 moves the phone replay and so the AUDIO; its measured onset 24.195 is in NOTES.md). Body pass 2026-11-20: the words the cuts, EV events and beats are anchored on. Convention: a word starts at its first phone, stop closures included (a closure shared by two stops is split in the middle). The build applies a value only when it is within 0.25 s of its own estimate, and lists every move.
